															? Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) – RRB ALP CEN.No:01/2026 Recruitment

															Q1. What is the total number of vacancies in RRB ALP 2026?
															A: There are 11,127 vacancies announced for the post of Assistant Loco Pilot (ALP) in various RRB zones across India.

															Q2. What is the application start and end date?
															A: The online application begins on 15 May 2026 and the last date to apply and pay the fee is 14 June 2026.

															Q3. What is the age limit for RRB ALP 2026?
															A:

															
																Minimum Age: 18 years
																Maximum Age:
																UR/EWS: 30 years
																OBC: 33 years
																SC/ST: 35 years
																Age is calculated as on 01 July 2026.
															

															Q4. What is the required educational qualification?
															A: Candidates must have Matriculation / SSLC along with an ITI certificate in relevant trade or a Diploma in Engineering from a recognized institution.

															Q5. How can I apply for RRB ALP 2026?
															A: Visit the official RRB regional website, register, fill out the form, upload documents, pay the fee, and submit your application online.

															Q6. What is the selection process?
															A: The selection will be done in the following stages:

															
																CBT 1 (Computer Based Test)
																CBT 2
																Computer-Based Aptitude Test (CBAT)
																Document Verification (DV)
															

															Q7. What is the salary for ALP posts?
															A: The salary is as per Pay Level 2 of the 7th CPC, with attractive allowances, job security, and growth opportunities.
